info.title: VAT Rates by IP API Reference
info.description: Get VAT rates for a country resolved from an IP address. Returns standard and reduced VAT rates based on the geographic location of the IP.

servers.description: VAT Rates by IP API Server

get.summary: Get VAT rate by IP address
get.description: Fetches VAT rate based on the specified or originating IP address.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Specify the desired response format. Options: 'json' (default) or 'xml'.

parameters.name: ipAddress
parameters.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address to look up VAT rate for. If omitted, the originating IP address will be used.

stateLevel.summary: IP resolved to a US state with sub-national sales tax

value.message: Invalid IP address format. Please provide a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address.

NotFound.summary: VAT data not found for IP

value.message: No VAT data found. Please provide a valid ipAddress.

ApiKeyAuthHeader.name: X-apiKey
ApiKeyAuthHeader.description: Pass your API key via the X-apiKey request header.

ApiKeyAuthQuery.name: apiKey
ApiKeyAuthQuery.description: Pass your API key via the apiKey query parameter.

VatIpItemArray.description: Array of VAT rate objects for the country resolved from the IP address.

VatIpItem.description: Each item in the array represents a VAT rate object for the country resolved from the IP.

country.description: Country resolved from the IP address.

state.description: State or region resolved from the IP address, for countries with sub-national tax rates (e.g. US). Only present when applicable.

type.description: Tax type for the resolved country (e.g., vat).

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the resolved country.

standard_rate.description: Standard VAT rate as a decimal.

categories.description: Category-specific VAT rates, where defined (EU/UK only). Keys vary by country.

VatRateDecimal.description: A VAT rate expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.19 = 19%).

VatCategories.description: Category-specific VAT rates, where defined (EU/UK only). Keys vary by country.

books.description: VAT rate for books, as a decimal (e.g., 0.07 = 7%).

newspapers.description: VAT rate for newspapers, as a decimal (e.g., 0.07 = 7%).

periodicals.description: VAT rate for periodicals, as a decimal (e.g., 0.07 = 7%).

broadcasting.description: VAT rate for broadcasting services, as a decimal (e.g., 0.19 = 19%).

error.description: Short error category or exception type.

message.description: Human-readable error message describing the failure.

path.description: API endpoint path that produced the error.

status.description: HTTP status code returned with the error.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error envelope returned by the API on failed requests.
